'''Land O' Capes''' was a [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] store located in the town [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]]<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/missing-in-action-trivia-gallery|text="Missing in Action" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 12}}</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MIA" /> It specialized in [[Cape/Legends|capes]].<ref name="Trivia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The establishment name is a reference to the character [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who is often wearing in a cape in the [[original trilogy]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
